name: ms-property-tax-landholding-stamp-duty
description: Montserrat property taxes for 2026: annual property tax under the Property Tax Act, Cap. 17.16 (residential 0.50% land and 0.25% buildings, commercial and hotel 1.00% and 0.50%, agricultural 0.20% land, EC$150,000 off a dwelling's value, 5% early payment rebate, exemptions and objections), the alien landholding licence under the Landholding Control Act, Cap. 8.02 (5% of consideration or EC$2,500 to own, 15% of annual rental value or EC$1,500 to lease, general licence EC$2,500 and EC$1,000), conveyance stamp duty under the Stamp Act, Cap. 17.02 (EC$5 per EC$250 or part above EC$2,000) and the 0.75% registration fee under the Registered Land Act. Trigger phrases include Montserrat property tax, landholding licence, alien land licence Montserrat, stamp duty Montserrat, buying property in Montserrat.
